MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive magnets feel like a natural addition to my tape and hook-and-loop strips because they offer another way to mount things removably in my workshop.",
    "The woodworking compass fits my fabrication work because marking circles and transferring spacing would help me prepare parts before drilling or cutting."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The printer controller, replacement wheels, and filament assume a printing project or compatible equipment that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "Owning drill bits does not mean I can use an end mill, and buying assorted fasteners does not mean I currently need specialized floorboard screws or clamps for matching ferrules.",
    "Another digital caliper is relevant to my work, but I already have one and see no clear reason here to replace it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in tools and fabrication seems to have been stretched into an assumed need for electronics prototyping and 3D printing supplies.",
    "My fastener purchases seem to have been treated as interest in any fastening product, even when its dimensions, connection type, or bulk quantity require a specific project."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My mounting supplies suggest interest in practical ways to attach and organize things, which makes removable adhesive magnets more useful to me than equipment-specific replacement parts.",
    "A useful addition to my existing tools matters more than another item with the same purpose; the compass adds a marking capability, while the caliper duplicates one I already own.",
    "Whether I have the matching equipment and an immediate use matters, especially for specialized components and large packs of consumables."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my fastening and fabrication interests but assume too many specialized projects and overlook what I already own."
}
